title: Preserve a restored closing outcome for its exact still-held owner after cached focus changes
outcome: A restored attributed closing job can deliver its original still-held owner's outcome when the session cache now points to a different claim. Source and checks are withheld when their original scope cannot be re-proved.
acceptance: A restored selected job keeps A's outcome under a populated B cache when A remains exactly held.
The closely matched lost-owner case refuses delivery, and the stale attributed source and checks remain withheld.
